director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko cricket pitch ki number line par dekhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket player kaun hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
haan samajh gayi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Upar theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh upar line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
samajh nahi aaya
1/3 ka neeche wala number 3 dekho: woh batata hai 0 se 1 ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatna hai. 1/3 unme se ek gap hai.
thoda hindi mein samjhao

Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Line ke theek beech mein ek mark hai. Woh line ko do barabar gaps mein baant-ta hai, isliye uska naam 1/2 hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ghar se chai ki dukaan tak sadak hai, 0 se 1 km. Upar woh 7 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Khilona chala aur pehle mark par ruk gaya. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, aur us jagah ka number hai 1/7 kilometre. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya
Khilona hawa mein nahi, sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai. Us jagah ka bhi number hai, 1/7 kilometre. Ab tak samajh aaya?
drawing karke samjhao
Is par doosri tasveer nahi ban paa rahi; jo board par hai, usi ko dekho. Neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona neeche 0 ke baad paanchve mark par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
director.card: Neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona neeche 0 ke baad paanchve mark par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

director.text: 5 and 6

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Neeche bhi wahi sadak hai, 6 barabar gaps mein. 0 se paanchve mark tak kitne gap hain, gino. 6 barabar gaps wali neeche ki sadak par 0 ke baad paanchva mark kis number par hai?
director.card: Neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona neeche 0 ke baad paanchve mark par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Is sawaal ka jawab 5/6 km hai, kyunki neeche sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur paanchva mark 0 se paanch gap par hai: ek pakki jagah, 5/6 kilometre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
haan
Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: pehle main try karun?
Haan, pehle tum try karo. Lo, sawaal yeh hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: usi line par

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki neeche ka 3 matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps, aur pehla gap isi line par khatam hota hai. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe cricket pasand hai

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 8 barabar gaps

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par upar 8 barabar gaps hain. 7 gaps se zyada gaps, toh har ek chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8, bilkul 0 se chipka hua. Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
8 gaps hue toh pehla mark 1/8 ekdum 0 ke paas aa gaya. Gaps jitne zyada, pehla mark 0 ke utna hi paas. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/8 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Upar aur neeche, dono ek hi line hain, 0 se 1 tak: wahi ek poora. Fraction ka neeche wala number jitna bada, wahi poora utne zyada barabar gaps mein bata, aur har gap utna chhota. Bada number matlab bada gap nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Cricket mein tumhe kya karna sabse achha lagta hai?
bowling karna
Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna. Ab wapas apne kaam par aate hain. Upar pehla mark 1/5 hai, neeche line 6 barabar gaps mein. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
director.card: Upar pehla mark 1/5 hai, neeche line 6 barabar gaps mein. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai bowling karna.

director.text: 1/5 se pehle

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 6 gaps wala har gap 5 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/6, 0 aur 1/5 ke beech rukta hai. Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Ghar se school tak 1 km ka raasta hai, aur beech mein 3 khambe barabar doori par hain. Pehla khamba kahan hai, yeh dhoondhna hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai.
hmm, achha
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
theek hai
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: ek chauthai

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/11 hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

director.text: right

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Socho ek roti 4 logon mein bati, ya 11 logon mein. Jis baar hissa chhota mile, woh line par pehle rukta hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai: yeh sahi hai ya galat?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

director.text: right
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab: sahi nahi, kyunki wahi poora 11 mein bata toh har gap chhota, isliye 1/11 pehle rukta hai, 1/4 se pehle; Zoya galat hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Is sawaal ka jawab: sahi nahi, kyunki ek pizza 11 logon mein bate toh har ek ko 4 logon wale se chhota hissa milta hai; 1/11 chhota hai, isliye line par 1/4 se pehle aata hai, aur Zoya galat hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe nahi pata
Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: the 1st mark hai na

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai Riya, tum aaj ke liye rokna chahti ho, maine sun liya. Ab teen raaste hain: aage badhein, thoda viraam lein, ya aaj yahin samaapt karein.
